findings: AcademyContainerBlockEntity.setItems broadcast UPDATE_ALL for every menu inventory save while native slots already synchronized the same items.
Shared BE getUpdateTag serialized all contentItems into chunk and block packets.
Client AcademyMenuContainer reloaded the BE inventory on every slot access, so compact BE snapshots would erase or replace native menu slot state.
MatrixRender was the only production block renderer reading machine inventory, for the valid core plus three constraint-plate condition.
changes: Keep setItems persistence dirty marking; remove the generic inventory block-update broadcast.
Keep saveAdditional/loadAdditional inventory schema and item components intact; omit contentItems only from getUpdateTag.
Use a per-menu client inventory initialized by native content/slot packets; server menus retain the live BE inventory and replacement-instance validity guard.
Matrix publishes render_core_level and render_has_materials in update tags, never in persistent saves, and broadcasts only a changed material signature.
Matrix renderer reads the summary through hasInitializationMaterials; working/wind/config state packets and native ContainerData remain in use.
Update two existing MachineVisualGate battery fixtures to EnergyItemHelper instead of legacy damage encoding.

coverage: Native save/loadStatic preserves all inventory counts and components across 15 registered machine block types; tracking tags omit inventory.

Two ordinary ServerPlayers receive native initial inventory and changed slot/data packets, idle and observer receive none, native pickup conserves cursor/inventory count, closed menu stops, replacing BE invalidates old menu and retains saved contents.

Matrix snapshot retains appearance summary, omits custom inventory NBT, excludes render fields from persistence, and encoded native packet bodies are smaller than reconstructed 0.0.30 inventory snapshots.
tests_added.client_coverage: Real integrated-server menu opening and item mutation; actual native slot/data/world packets; MetalFormer world mode changes do not erase cached slots; Matrix core/plate summary tracks insert/remove without full inventory in client BE.
